run_yelp_teacher: run the YelpTeacher to load and serve Yelp gender classification data for dialogue training
build_yelp_data: build the Yelp gender classification training and validation datasets from raw fader files
check_yelp_data_download: check whether Yelp MD gender data is downloaded and build derived files if needed
load_yelp_gender_data: load Yelp gender data for train, valid, or test splits with male and female labels
setup_yelp_teacher_data: setup Yelp teacher data with optional unknown classes and partner neutral examples
